label: Fires at D1 after a1 led rarely to S2, most if unrewarded following a rewarded trial.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 r') ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 u') ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * (tv('state', -2) == 2)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u")
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Magnitude is set by the previous trial: a1 -> S2 (rare transition) raises it, unrewarded (~+1.8 residual) far more than rewarded (~+0.8); all S1 outcomes lower it below baseline, a2 S2 u slightly raises it. Within a1 S2 u, it is much larger when the trial before was rewarded (and when it reached S1), i.e. a first surprising rare-unrewarded outcome; repeated a1 S2 u streaks give weak activations. The free fit adds the trial-before-state term, a small a2 S2 u term and a weak belief_lo slope for S2 trials (dev 0.558 vs short 0.533). No future, hidden or model-output variables used.

issues: The main claims hold up. The feature is zero at GO and D2 (the timing baseline is 0 there). At D1 the residual by previous trial is a1 S2 u +1.77, a1 S2 r +0.84, a2 S2 u +0.11 and about -0.25 after every other pattern. The recorded short form scores test R^2 0.524 beyond timing, as reported.

The third term picks the wrong conditioning. Splitting a1 S2 u by the reward two trials back (free fit, test 0.556) gives weights of 2.39 when that trial was rewarded, 1.83 when it is unknown (outside the window) and only 0.39 when it was unrewarded. The recorded term (tv('reward',-2)==1) lumps the high 'unknown' cases in with the low 'unrewarded' ones. Using (tv('reward',-2)==0) instead scores test 0.550.

Conditioning on the state reached two trials back works better still: a1 S2 r ;; a1 S2 u ;; a1 S2 u * (tv('state',-2)==2) scores dev 0.563 and test 0.554, with weights +0.90, +2.19 and -2.07. So after a1 S2 u the feature fires about 2.2 unless the trial before also reached S2, in which case it is near 0.1. The label's 'following a rewarded trial' should say 'following a trial that reached S1'. That is the 'first surprising S2 outcome' story the explanation itself gives.

Misses on the short form show no large systematic class. D1 after S1 trials is over-predicted by about 0.2 and D1 after a2 S2 u under-predicted by +0.16, both small intercept-level offsets. The worst windows are at the window's first trial, where the previous trial is unobservable, so no in-window term can fix them.
The weak belief_lo slope from the free fit does not help in a short form: replacing the third term with a1 S2 u * belief_lo drops test R^2 to 0.475.
The label leaves out the small a2 S2 u bump (+0.11); this is minor.
skeptic.revised_label: D1 after a1 rarely reached S2, strongest if unrewarded and the previous trial reached S1.
